name: 37043 · Clarksville, TN
findings: ZIP 37043 (Clarksville) has 149 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37043 (Clarksville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37043 (Clarksville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 59 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
